data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'sadélle', meaning 'to offer, to pay'. The name Sadella carries the meaning “Jewel of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
